Score 95 with RSI 62.4 (less overbought than peers), MACD bullish crossover, and price above SMA-20, deploying idle cash into an open slot per risk rules.

decisions.briefing: Markets were neutral today (NASDAQ +0.8%, S&P 500 +0.3%) with no major risk-off signals. With $889 in cash and 3 open slots, we deployed into two of the highest-scoring momentum candidates, NWCL and NICE, both showing bullish MACD and RSI setups.

market_education.summary_en: Markets drifted modestly higher today with the NASDAQ up 0.8% and the S&P 500 up 0.3%, reflecting a broadly neutral risk environment without a clear catalyst. Trading stayed range-bound as investors awaited fresh economic data or earnings signals. No major headlines drove significant moves in either direction.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市溫和上揚，納指升0.8%，標普500指數升0.3%，反映市場情緒中性，缺乏明顯催化劑。投資者在等待新的經濟數據或業績消息期間，成交維持區間波動，未見重大消息主導市場方向。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum investing means buying stocks that are already trending upward, using indicators like RSI and MACD to confirm the trend is likely to continue. Today's buys were chosen because they showed multiple bullish signals — rising price above their moving average and a bullish MACD crossover — suggesting continued upward momentum.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動量投資是指買入已經呈上升趨勢的股票，並利用RSI和MACD等指標確認趨勢有機會持續。今日選中的股票同時出現多項看漲訊號——股價高於移動平均線及MACD黃金交叉——顯示上升動力有望延續。
